text:
nina: flagging Q2 priority: customers asking for lightweight way to run multiple tool calls from a single chat turn. they want patterns: fanout + gather, ordered pipeline, and race-first-success. we need to pick an MVP that balances simplicity + power.
sam: agreeto. short checklist: 1) clear modes 2) sane defaults for timeouts/retries 3) observability per-subcall 4) predictable cost accounting.
leo: runtime constraints: fanout kills batching and increases KV pressure. pipeline needs persistent in-request KV that survives step boundaries. race needs cancel semantics to free GPU/time.
anya: ops note: we must enforce per-request concurrency limits by default and a cluster-wide safety net. also need per-tool qps throttles and circuits for noisy integrations.
michael: suggest a minimal API surface with three modes: "parallel" (fire all), "ordered" (seq with state), "first_success" (parallel + cancel). default = "ordered" to be conservative.
nina: sketch for POST payload (MVP):

```json
{
  "mode":"ordered|parallel|first_success",
  "steps":[
    {"id":"fetch","tool":"user_lookup","timeout_ms":400},
    {"id":"score","tool":"reranker","depends_on":["fetch"],"retry":1}
  ],
  "stop_on":"first_success|k_successes",
  "overall_timeout_ms":2000
}
```

sam: important: make retries opt-in per-step and require idempotency_key for auto-retries when tool side-effects exist. by default no automatic retries for parallel.
leo: state binding options: option A = implicit server-scoped KV for the request (automatic, easiest for SDKs), option B = explicit state blob passed between steps (easier for private infra and portable). recommend A for devex MVP, add B later.
anya: rollout plan: 1) feature flag in hosted for 10% orgs 2) metrics + tracing enabled (per-step latency, cancellations, retries) 3) limit fanout degree to 10 for GA 4) circuit breakers on noisy tools.
michael: launch criteria proposal: API RFC merged, SDK examples for node/python, per-step metrics in console, SLO: 99% of ordered flows complete within overall_timeout at <10% fanout, infra throttles verified.
nina: edge cases: - what about partial failures in parallel? return per-step status and a top-level success boolean. - ordering guarantees: ordered must be strictly sequential; if a step fails, downstream steps must see failure and either abort or run with fallback flag.
sam: security/permissions: require per-tool ACL scope and audit log for each call. also support run-as-service-account header.
leo: perf: pipelines should reuse KV/cache so subsequent LM calls can do prefix caching. add an explicit cache_hint per-step.
anya: ops TODOs: add per-tool rate-limit config in admin, enforce default concurrency=4 per request, add cancellation endpoint /v1/actions/cancel?thread=...
michael: doc/SDK owner: @sam, infra owner: @anya, runtime owner: @leo. can we get an RFC by Thursday and a brief demo in next product sync?
nina: decision for MVP scope: include ordered + parallel + first_success, per-step timeouts, per-step opt-in retries with idempotency key, implicit request-KV, per-step observability. defer DAGs > linear dependency lists, cross-region routing, and auto-retries for non-idempotent tools.
deploy-bot: rollout flagged: feature.actions_concurrent set for 10% orgs as of 1800000300. :rocket:
